<props="china">如果使用的是云手机矩阵版，并且实例串流模式为协同模式，则可以通过指定`EndUserId`的方式断开指定用户的连接，并且令相应的Ticket失效。</props>

<props="intl">本参数暂不对外开放使用。</props>
description.en:
<props="china">

If you use the Cloud Phone Matrix Edition and the instance stream pattern is collaborative mode, you can specify `EndUserId` to disconnect a specific user and invalidate the corresponding ticket.

</props>

<props="intl">

This parameter is not publicly available.

</props>

description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表，可设置 1~100 个。
description.en: A list of instance IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

descriptions.zh:
实例的连接通过[web sdk](~~2858136~~)完成。通过`session.stop()`断开连接后，系统仍会保持5分钟的用户与云机的连接绑定关系，这5分钟内其他用户不可连接，此时可通过`DisconnectAndroidInstance`接口进行立即解绑。
<props="china">如果使用的是云手机矩阵版，并且实例串流模式为协同模式，则可以通过指定`EndUserId`的方式断开指定用户的连接，并且令相应的Ticket失效。</props>
descriptions.en:
Connections to instances are established using the [](t2848888.xdita#). After a connection is closed with `session.stop()`, the system maintains the user-instance association for 5 minutes. During this time, other users cannot connect. The `DisconnectAndroidInstance` operation lets you disassociate the instance immediately.
<props="china">If you use the Cloud Phone Matrix Edition and the instance stream pattern is collaborative mode, you can specify `EndUserId` to disconnect a specific user and invalidate the corresponding ticket.</props>
